web.note: Silo's web client translations: <path>/<tag>.json of the repository at the commit, one file per language, each pinned by the SHA-256 of the whole file. scripts/sync-web-texts.ps1 checks them and keeps the keys src/Granary.Core/Texts/Catalogs/web-keys.txt lists, in src/Granary.Core/Texts/Catalogs/web/<tag>.json. Move the pin with the script's -Commit, not by hand (docs/release.md, "Translations").
